prompt: What was the founding name of the company that ran the coal mining camp in the city where baseball great Willie Mays was born?
answer: The company was founded as the **Tennessee Coal, Iron and Railroad Company (TCI&R)**, commonly called the **Tennessee Coal & Iron Company**. It later became part of **U.S. Steel**.
